params.name: contains
params.description:
Filter for notebooks that match a provided filter.
                Each match pair is separated by a colon,
                multiple match pairs can be sent separated by a space or a comma

params.name: created_by
params.description: The UUID of the Notebook's creator

params.name: date_from
params.description: Filter for notebooks created after this date & time

params.name: date_to
params.description: Filter for notebooks created before this date & time

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.

params.name: user
params.description: If any value is provided for this parameter, return notebooks created by the logged in user.
